usedFor: Shopify holds store customers, and CallHippo receives each as a contact through “Create a Contact” when “New Customer” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in CallHippo
bestTemplate.why: A new customer lands in CallHippo as a contact, ready for your team to call.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a template built on it runs after a scheduled check.
